propertyEvents.result: Compare the year with last year, and each month with the rest
propertyEvents.locator: General Ledger!A8:H2061; FY2025 closings and payments

propertyEvents.result: Book income rose from $70,000.00 to $244,500.00 (249%). The price per unit rose from $28,400.00 to $31,500.00 and the cost per unit from $26,500.00 to $27,774.04, so the gross margin went from 6.7% to 11.8%. June has 60 progress payments, $186,000.00, about what 6.7 units cost, and no closings; all 3 June picks say completion and punch list. Both are questions for Morgan Lee and judgments for the CPA.
propertyEvents.locator: General Ledger!A8:H2061; FY2025 closings and payments

propertyEvents.result: Cash ties to the bank's letter · no loans · book income up 249% · June payments with no closings
Ready for the CPA
Add up what was found and set it against materiality

Known misstatements add up to $2,150.00, 18% of the $12,000.00 materiality and under performance materiality of $9,000.00. 1 clearly trivial item is listed but not added up. Judgments and open evidence could raise book income by up to $10,500.00. Comparing the totals with materiality and concluding is the CPA’s job; the machine stops here.
